C-B=+1.629 (5/5 seeds favor B). No sign reversal across all 3 test subjects. Both the pre-fix single-fold diagnostic and the pre-fix full 6-fold CV are marked INVALIDATED_BY_REFERENCE_SIGNAL_QUALITY_DEFECT. See docs/GALAXYPPG_STAGE3_CORRECTED_RESULTS.md.
